name: Shenzhou 14
about: Shenzhou 14 (2022-060A), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou), launched 2022 Jun  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Jun  5), held fixed
docked to S48274; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q107258411), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
